draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.97, the 154th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 221, well after his grade rank (154th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Josh Shaw. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile). College production: 7 passes defended in 2021, 8th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.
